persons.name: Vāṇīprakāśa
persons.evidence: vāṇipūrva khalu prakāśaśarmaṇā lekhanaṃ tu hitatayā tadā kṛtaṃ

date.as_written: śrīśāke 1717 māse5 ākṣivāṇavasusarvarī kare vikramārkaśakakālake gate

notes: The chronogram 'ākṣivāṇavasusarvarīkare' encodes the Vikramārka (Vikrama) year: akṣi (2), bāṇa (5), vasu (8), śarvarīkara (1) = VS 1852, alongside the numeric Śaka year 1717.
